_comment: Derived from sigil_of_suffering_red, whose printed functional text is byte-identical. Colour variants differ only in {p} and pitch, and both come from card data rather than this file, so the abilities carry over unchanged. Verified against the corpus as its own card. INHERITED NOTE FROM sigil_of_suffering_red: The DEFENSE_REACTION carried a SET_FLAG SIGIL_OF_SUFFERING_ARCANE_DEALT that nothing read. Its job -- remembering 'you have dealt arcane damage this turn' -- is already done generically by effect_keywords.deal_damage, which records did_this_turn:damage:arcane for EVERY source. The WHILE_STATIC below reads that marker, so the private flag was a second, broken copy of a record that was already being kept correctly.

abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches, and MODIFY_DEFENSE_VALUE wrote combat.total_defense, which _resolve_damage recomputes from sum(card.defense) immediately before damage -- so the value was discarded even when something did set it. WHILE_STATIC on RECALC_DEFENSE with MODIFY_DEFENSE moves the DEFENDING CARD's own {d}, which is what survives into the total. The condition was FLAG_SET on a private flag nothing ever set.
